target_product.review_text:
To be honest, I was intrigued by the mention of the product being a "2021 UPGRADED" version of massage tools. Nowhere in the product details, or within the product, is any comment on the specific upgrade. My examination of the massage tools found nothing extraordinary or innovative in the design or construction.
There is no enhancement to the gua sha, which does seem a bit thin. I will note that the massage roller has one feature found on better quality massage rollers.
The massage roller includes a metal collar where the metal axle meets the jade roller. While this is more of a cosmetic affect, it's still a nice visual design element. The jade stone rollers have excellent coloration. The rollers have decent polishing, retaining some natural feel but having a nice shine. The plastic grommet inserts are present, which facilitates a quiet and smooth rolling behavior. The inserts, acting as bearings, also protects the jade and the metal axles from erosive interaction. The massage roller is visually attractive, with good design elements and quality construction.
The gua sha, as mentioned before, is a bit thin. The jade composition has a coloration similar to the jade rollers, perhaps with a bit more lighter shades. The gua sha also has a decent polish, which retains some natural texture.
Priced at slightly under $13, the cost is appropriate for the quality of jade stone and design. Attached are photos to show real world images, with a ruler for size reference. Most of the photos confirm the rich coloration of the jade elements.
While I don't really 'see' the upgraded aspects (unless their previous version didn't have the plastic bearings, which would be a low quality product), this is still a very credible massage roller and gua sha set. I really like the quality and coloration of the jade components. As such, the set earns a 4.5+ star rating, with a high level recommendation.

product_meta.title: URBEST Electric Hand Massager, Cordless Rechargeable Wrist Finger Massager with Heat and 3 Levels Air Compression

target_product.review_text:
This massager is pretty neat. I have tried one or two others that were very similar although I think I prefer this one. Wy? Because unlike the two others that REALLY crushed my wrist – like trying to remove it from my hand – with some of the settings – nothing here does that. Sure, on some of the modes you feel it more in the wrist area – but it is not too crazy.

It is easy to operate and there are three main modes and then three levels of intensity for each. There is also one button for heat – and let’s face it, who doesn’t always want to use the heat? : ) It is easy to charge and the charge seems to last quite a long time – definitely multiple uses easily. It also has clear instructions of how your hand should fit and rest – the others I have tied had no such instruction. So, this is helpful for proper placement of your hands.

If you are not used to this type of machine, I would definitely say work up to the strongest modes. Personally, I like to star on the first mode at the lowest setting. After a few minutes I switch it to the next mode on the lowest setting, then after a few more – the next mode. Then I circle back to the first mode but put it on level 2 – and then I do the same for the next two modes. Circling back once again, I do each for a few minutes at the highest intensity. When I remove my hands – the dots are present in my skin – but my hands feel great. Working up is the way to go. I really do like using this machine.
I hope that you have found my review “helpful”. : ) Enjoy your day! : )
target_product.review_title: Sort of weird at first - but does leave hands feeling good
